Company careers page — Tasks

Spec: spec-HIRE-7-company-careers-page | Size: S | Tasks: 2

Phase 1: Frontend

  • [x] 1. Careers page (nextjs)

    • Covers: AC-1, AC-2
    • [x] 1.1 app/companies/[slug]/page.tsx: load getCompany(slug) and searchJobs({ company: slug }) in parallel; notFound() when the company is null
    • [x] 1.2 Profile header (name, location, website, description) and the open jobs list with JobCard; "See all N jobs" link to /jobs?company=<slug> when there are more than one page
    • [x] 1.3 No loading.tsx in app/companies/[slug]/: a loading boundary streams a 200 response before notFound() runs, which would break AC-2
    • [x] 1.4 Verify: /companies/acme-robotics renders; /companies/no-such-company shows the not-found page with status 404; gates green

  • [x] 2. Rating summary and job-detail company link (nextjs)

    • Covers: AC-3, MNC-2
    • [x] 2.1 Add listCompanyReviews(slug, 1) to the parallel load; a 404 from it yields no summary instead of an error
    • [x] 2.2 Show average_rating to one decimal and the approved review count, or "No reviews yet"; link to /companies/<slug>/reviews
    • [x] 2.3 Link the company name in app/jobs/[id]/page.tsx to /companies/<slug>
    • [x] 2.4 Verify: summary matches curl -s localhost:8000/api/v1/companies/acme-robotics/reviews | jq .meta; /jobs unchanged; gates green; npm run build passes (new route)
